description: This file defines a Java entity class 'CreditBureauConfiguration' that models the configuration for credit bureaus in the system. It includes fields for configuration key, value, description, and a relationship to an OrganisationCreditBureau. It provides methods to create an instance from a JSON command and to update its fields based on JSON input.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing credit bureau configuration settings, with methods to instantiate from JSON input and update fields based on changes.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method to create a CreditBureauConfiguration object from a JsonCommand and an OrganisationCreditBureau reference.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the configuration fields based on changes detected in the JsonCommand; returns a map of actual changes made.
